<script id="fem-post-rating-js-after">
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  document.querySelectorAll('.fem-rating-box').forEach(function (box) {
    const stars = Array.from(box.querySelectorAll('.fem-star'));
    const message = box.querySelector('.fem-rating-message');
    const avg = box.querySelector('.fem-rating-average');
    const count = box.querySelector('.fem-rating-count');

    function paint(value) {
      stars.forEach(function (star) {
        star.classList.toggle('is-active', Number(star.dataset.rating) <= value);
      });
    }

    stars.forEach(function (star) {
      star.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { paint(Number(star.dataset.rating)); });
      star.addEventListener('focus', function () { paint(Number(star.dataset.rating)); });
      star.addEventListener('click', function () {
        const rating = Number(star.dataset.rating);
        const body = new URLSearchParams({
          action: 'fem_rate_post',
          nonce: FEMRating.nonce,
          post_id: box.dataset.postId,
          rating: rating
        });

        stars.forEach(function (s) { s.disabled = true; });
        message.textContent = 'Guardando tu valoración…';

        fetch(FEMRating.ajaxUrl, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8' },
          body: body.toString()
        })
        .then(function (response) { return response.json(); })
        .then(function (data) {
          if (!data.success) throw new Error(data.data && data.data.message ? data.data.message : 'No se pudo guardar la valoración.');
          avg.textContent = Number(data.data.average).toFixed(1);
          count.textContent = data.data.count;
          paint(rating);
          message.textContent = 'Gracias por tu valoración.';
        })
        .catch(function (error) {
          message.textContent = error.message;
          stars.forEach(function (s) { s.disabled = false; });
        });
      });
    });

    box.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { paint(0); });
  });
});
//# sourceURL=fem-post-rating-js-after
</script>
